label: Facing sidewalls
subgoals: Take the facing area as thickness times parallel run length
Divide by the spacing between the sidewalls
Scale by the permittivity of the dielectric between them

label: Spacing dependence
subgoals: Read the coupling per length at the tabulated spacing
Scale it by the ratio of old to new spacing
Multiply by the parallel run length

label: Parallel run length
subgoals: Find the interval where both wires exist on adjacent tracks
Take its length as the parallel run
Multiply the run by the coupling per length at that spacing
